title: Junior Crypto Trader
description:

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule.
  • Structured training program.
  • Career development opportunities.
  • Continuous mentorship.
  • International team.
  • Modern analytical tools.

Recruitment Process

description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary As a Project Operations Specialist, you will be a key member of the Talent Screening team and the operational partner who ensures screening work moves seamlessly from request to execution. You will coordinate sourcing requests, maintain screening readiness, monitor operational performance, support cross-service talent movement, and help launch new screening initiatives. In this role, you will own the day-to-day execution of screening operations by coordinating stakeholders, tracking dependencies, maintaining accurate documentation, identifying risks early, and ensuring work is completed on time. You will work closely with the Screening Operations Manager, Sourcing teams, Screeners, Analytics, Product, and other cross-functional partners. This is an individual contributor role with meaningful end-to-end ownership. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, analytical, proactive, and excels at bringing clarity and structure to complex operational workflows. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. • Coordinate sourcing requests from intake through launch, ensuring all required information is complete and requests meet the 24-hour preparation standard. • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements, track dependencies, resolve blockers, and ensure timely execution. • Maintain accurate operational trackers, documentation, decision logs, and process guidance. • Monitor screening readiness, capacity, funnel performance, and operational metrics, identifying risks and recommending improvements. • Escalate operational risks with clear context and recommended actions. • Support talent movement across services and acquired-company onboarding by coordinating screening requirements and stakeholder handoffs. • Coordinate screening path updates across operations, content, systems, and screeners to ensure successful implementation. • Perform data quality checks, investigate discrepancies, and maintain reliable operational reporting. • Serve as a primary operational point of contact for screening-related requests, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through. • Contribute to process improvements, documentation, and new screening initiatives that improve efficiency and scalability. In the first week, expect to: • Complete onboarding and become familiar with the Talent Screening team, systems, tools, and operational workflows. • Meet key stakeholders and gain an understanding of screening operations and business priorities. • Shadow sourcing request preparation, screening readiness reviews, and cross-functional processes. In the first month, expect to: • Build a solid understanding of the end-to-end screening process and operational workflows. • Begin managing sourcing requests and operational follow-ups with guidance from the Screening Operations Manager. • Develop effective working relationships with cross-functional partners. In the first three months, expect to: • Independently manage sourcing requests while maintaining the 24-hour preparation standard. • Monitor screening readiness, capacity, and operational health, proactively identifying risks and opportunities. • Recommend and implement improvements to workflows, documentation, or operational processes. In the first six months, expect to: • Own operational execution across your assigned scope with minimal oversight. • Support the launch and scaling of new screening initiatives and operational improvements, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. • Drive efficiencies by improving processes, documentation, and operational reporting. In the first year, expect to: • Become a trusted operational partner across the Talent Screening organization. • Help build scalable, transparent operational processes that support business growth. • Influence operational improvements through data-driven insights and cross-functional collaboration. • Be recognized for consistently delivering operational excellence, strong ownership, and reliable execution. Qualifications and Job Requirements: • Bachelor’s Degree is required. • 2-4+ years of experience in operations, talent operations, project coordination, program management, or a similar cross-functional environment. • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders while maintaining strong attention to detail. • Strong analytical skills with experience using operational data to identify trends, solve problems, and improve processes. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate priorities, risks, and recommendations. • Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets and operational tracking tools; experience with dashboards, workflow automation, or low-code/no-code tools is a plus. • Strong process orientation with a continuous improvement mindset. • High level of ownership, accountability, and follow-through. • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities. • Experience supporting talent screening, marketplace operations, or technology-enabled operations is preferred. • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Technical Sales Representative - (October 2026 Start Date)
Sustainability advisor
description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We are looking for an experienced sustainability professional to join our growing Sustainability Advisor team and accelerate the adoption of best-in-class corporate sustainability programs. This is an opportunity to work directly with some of the world’s largest and most influential companies including Walmart, BlackRock, BBVA, Coty, ISS, and Smiths Group as a trusted advisor, while partnering across product and go-to-market teams to serve as a thought leader and embed best-in-class sustainability intelligence into our products.

Watershed's customers represent over 2 gigatons of annual emissions; if they were a country, they would rank sixth globally (just behind Russia). In this role, you'll partner directly with the corporate leaders reshaping our planet's future. You'll be on the front lines of the climate fight - crafting the sustainability strategies that make business sense, and set the stage for bold action. This role will be based out of our London office. Expectation in this role around autonomy and independent execution is most closely matched by senior manager (or higher) levels of tenure in consulting firms.

You will:

  • Advise sustainability leaders at many of the world's leading companies on advancing their sustainability programs. You'll independently lead strategic engagements across target-setting, decarbonization, environmental impact management, and voluntary and regulatory reporting, partnering closely with customers to craft the business case for sustainability across every step of the journey.

  • Build sustainability intelligence by staying ahead of emerging frameworks, regulations, and market developments. You'll translate the latest sustainability trends and regulatory changes into actionable guidance for internal teams and customers, ensuring they stay compliant and competitive.

  • Help Watershed develop new products and services by exploring sustainability needs in emerging topics and industries and prototyping how we bring value to customers. You'll expand Watershed's impact by identifying opportunities and building solutions at the intersection of sustainability, advisory, and technology.

You might be a fit if you have:

  • 8-15+ years of professional experience including at least 2 years at a consulting firm with demonstrated excellence in client-facing roles and at least 4 years in sustainability (experience can overlap).

  • Have expertise in corporate decarbonization, are familiar with key climate frameworks such as GHGP, PCAF, SBTi, ISO, and key reporting frameworks such as CSRD, CCDAA, ASRS, ISSB, CDP, etc.

  • Think clearly about complex problems and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are systematic, detail-oriented, and thrive in fast-paced environments.

  • Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can present complex analyses and recommendations to C-suite audiences and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excel at driving strategic initiatives in complex organizations. You can influence decision-making while managing multiple internal and external stakeholders across different organizational levels.

  • Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to define the future of corporate sustainability at a high-growth startup.

Considered nice to have if you have:

  • Have direct experience decarbonizing global scope 1 and 2 footprints

  • Have direct experience supporting asset managers and other financial institutions run their sustainability programs

  • Have direct experience decarbonizing physical supply chains

  • Have previous experience working in SaaS climate tech

  • Have an advanced degree in sustainability, climate science, environmental engineering, or related technical fields.

  • Are fluent in multiple languages (English, Spanish, French, or German).

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.
